ARGUS LOOKED THIS UP ON SEPTEMBER 9, 2026
Summarize Apple's latest quarterly earnings report: revenue, year-over-year growth, and what the company said about iPhone.

Apple’s latest report was a record June quarter. For its fiscal third quarter ended June 27, 2026, Apple reported $109.4 billion in revenue, an increase of 16% year over year.

On iPhone: Apple said iPhone revenue set a new June-quarter record and highlighted double-digit growth. The filing shows iPhone sales of $54.252 billion, versus $44.582 billion in the year-earlier quarter. CEO Tim Cook described the broader quarter as Apple’s strongest June quarter ever, with growth across every geographic segment.
